name: Solomon USDv (Legacy)
oneLiner: USDV is Solomon Labs's synthetic dollar on Solana backed by Ceffu-custodied delta-neutral perp margin, with no permissionless public redemption rail.
collateral: Ceffu-custodied strategy assets and off-exchange delta-neutral margin used by Solomon Labs to back USDv
pegMechanism: USDv targets $1 through Solomon-managed strategy collateral, market liquidity, and approved/whitelisted participant redemption into USDC against a small documented protocol reserve buffer; no permissionless public holder redemption rail is disclosed

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Solomon's official launch history says USDv operated through a year-long live beta before its November 2025 public introduction, and describes the yield engine as a spot-long, perpetual-short basis trade across major cryptoassets. The issuer's current site independently describes USDv as operating live since late 2024 across Treasuries and delta-neutral strategies, supporting the synthetic-delta-neutral classification and a conservative Q4 2024 implementation date, stored at its range end (2024-12).

sources.label: Solomon official introduction and year-long beta disclosure

proofOfReserves.provider: Solomon legacy protocol-data API: issuer-reported Ceffu strategy and reserve components, with a material portion of protocol TVL unmapped. Replacement USDv reserve documentation does not establish the backing of this legacy mint.

notices.title: Legacy USDv wind-down
notices.message: This profile tracks the original Solomon USDv mint. Solomon announced that the legacy front end and support end October 16, 2026; the sUSDv unstaking-request deadline is October 9. The replacement USDv uses a different mint and reserve model, with no automatic conversion. Legacy rewards ended August 27.

notices.title: Partial reserve coverage
notices.message: At the September 14, 2026 reserve observation, the issuer API identified about 18.6% of reported protocol TVL; 81.4% remained unmapped. From the September 20, 2026 data cut the legacy protocol-data endpoint itemizes only vestigial components (Ceffu custody below $100, empty vault and reserve fund) and its protocol TVL headline now equals the replacement USDv mint's on-chain supply, so live tracking fails closed rather than attribute the replacement token's supply to this legacy mint. Exchange hedge notional and mirrored custody balances cannot be added as separate backing to fill that gap. The tracked legacy mint uses a Ceffu-custodied delta-neutral strategy; documentation for the replacement USDv does not establish this token's reserve composition.
